name: web-page-parity
description: Shareable Codex plugin for pixel-parity, screenshot comparison, and visual QA workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Match live pages to screenshots, PDFs, and mockups with repeatable visual evidence.
interface.longDescription: Packages a reusable visual parity workflow for comparing live pages against screenshots, PDFs, Figma exports, and browser comments using deterministic captures, side-by-side reports, OCR-assisted typography checks, and privacy-preserving capture defaults.
defaultPrompt: Use Web Page Parity to make this landing page match the provided PNG exactly.
Use Web Page Parity to compare the current page against this screenshot and report the remaining mismatches.
Use Web Page Parity to verify desktop and mobile visual parity before release.
